claims: Reports and social media rumors claiming that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has died or was assassinated are false as of March 15, 2026.
The Israeli Prime Minister's Office (PMO) has dismissed reports claiming that Benjamin Netanyahu has died or was assassinated as "fake news".
The Israeli Prime Minister's Office (PMO) confirmed that Netanyahu is "fine".
The Israeli Prime Minister's Office (PMO) confirmed that Netanyahu continues to lead the country.
The false claims gained momentum in early March 2026.
The false claims gained momentum during heightened tensions with Iran.
The false claims were fueled by unverified social media posts.
The false claims were fueled by AI-generated images.
The false claims were fueled by a manipulated video that appeared to show Netanyahu with "six fingers".
Netanyahu made a public appearance at a disaster site in Beit Shemesh.
Netanyahu held a March 13th, 2026 press conference.
